sub: Five moves that help med spas and wellness clinics turn searches into booked consults and repeat visits.

slides.title: Win the Google search first
slides.body:
New clients find you on Google, social media, AI search or word of mouth, then compare you with two or three others.
List every treatment as a service, add your booking link, and post real photos of your space and your team.
slides.tip: Search your top treatment plus your town. Are you in the top three?

slides.title: Teach, don't just pitch
slides.body:
Trust comes from credentials, real results and honest expectations.
Post what a first visit looks like, who a treatment is right for, downtime, and who your providers are.
slides.tip: Turn your five most-asked consult questions into five posts.

slides.title: Reply to reviews without confirming a patient
slides.body:
Thank every reviewer, but never confirm someone is a patient or mention their visit. The AMA says even acknowledging a patient is a risk.
Speak about your general policies and take details offline.
slides.tip: Write one approved reply template your whole team uses.

slides.title: Know Meta's ad rules before you boost
slides.body:
Meta requires ads for cosmetic procedures and weight loss to target people 18 or older.
Ads also can't imply or try to create negative self-perception, so lead with the experience and the provider, not a flaw.
slides.tip: Check Meta's health and wellness ad standards before every campaign.

slides.title: Follow up, rebook, then track it
slides.body:
A lead with no follow-up goes cold, and repeat visits and referrals are where growth compounds.
Text or email every inquiry fast, send rebooking reminders, and track booked consults by source.
slides.tip: Track two numbers monthly: consults booked by source and rebook rate.
